method: Every selected episode (all H504 10x episodes with a known peak and 20 seeded 5x episodes) was reviewed against three price facts from the screen: the adjusted/raw ratio gap equals the product of the window's corporate-action factors, no quality flag, and every adjusted daily move within the daily price limit (a wrong ex-date factor would breach it). The four episodes with a move beyond the limit and the largest factor gap (9906) were also read against raw closes, volume, listing date and the ex-right reference price.
